links.outcome: Trainee-reported alert fatigue with EHR sepsis alert
links.effect: Alert fatigue (62.5%) and limited clinical utility (46.3%) were major concerns among 80 trainees who recognized the sepsis alert.
links.quote: Alert fatigue (62.5%) and limited clinical utility (46.3%) were major concerns.

links.outcome: Trainee awareness and use of sepsis CDS tool features
links.effect: Among 80 who recognized the sepsis alert, only 11.3% had used the advisor; lack of awareness about advisor features and alert suppression limited engagement.
links.quote: Lack of awareness about advisor features and alert suppression mechanisms further limited engagement.

unlisted_practices: 'Patient already being treated' option to suppress alerts

screen.reason: Survey evaluating medical trainees' knowledge, utilization, and perceptions of EHR-integrated sepsis predictive/CDS tools in an academic health system.
